findings.description: The position of the man's hand and tool in the mirror does not match his actual body in the foreground. At 00:00-00:01 and 00:05-00:09, his foreground hand holds the tool under his chin and jawline, while the reflection shows him holding it up against his upper lip and cheek. Similarly, at 00:02 and 00:04, the foreground tool is near his temple while the reflection shows it over his eyebrow and nose bridge.
Continuous tooth-brushing audio plays throughout the video while the man rubs a toothbrush-like tool across his dry skin (chin, upper lip, eyebrow, and hair) rather than inside his mouth.
As the man tilts his head down between 00:02 and 00:03, his facial features in the mirror reflection morph into a noticeably different face before morphing back to his original appearance at 00:04.

The object in the man's hand changes shape and appearance, starting as a white toothbrush-like stick at 00:00-00:01, turning into a dark hair comb with teeth at 00:03 as he brushes his hair, and reverting to a thin white/grey stick at 00:04-00:09.
